source.quote: A reopen whose reason is an unavailable account or a crashed critic is not a work failure: the commits are already on the bead branch, so it is re-verified with `retry_verification`, never re-dispatched to a worker. Re-dispatch only when the reopen names missing commits, a failed check or a merge conflict.
